messages:
Ava (PM): quick sync — FinReg asked for a low-risk upgrade path for private deployments. they insist on zero-app-downtime, preservation of customer ASNs, and an auditable dry-run. can we map acceptance criteria and blocker list?
Mira (Eng Lead): putting initial list here. main concerns: installer idempotency across minor/major upgrades, routing transition window, and KV cache compatibility across versions.
Sam (Infra): also need to ensure control-plane upgrades don't flap dataplane. propose operator-shim flow that temporarily mirrors routes before cutover.
Rohit (Solutions): customer expects operator to keep BGP origin unchanged. they won't allow ephemeral ASNs. we should document a migrate-without-asn-change path.
Emily (Field): FinReg timeline = end of quarter. they want a dry-run in their staging env + runbook. must support offline verification steps for netops.
Priya (Security): telemetry must be opt-in for private installs (legal flagged this). any KMS/HSM integration needs explicit consent + audit log hooks.
Ava (PM): acceptance criteria draft: 1) dry-run mode that simulates upgrade without touching BGP 2) automated smoke test within 15m post-cutover 3) rollback path completes in <30m 4) telemetry off by default + explicit opt-in UI/flag 5) docs + runbook for netops + legal signoff. thoughts?
Mira (Eng Lead): realistic: rollback <30m for config drift only, full data rollback impossible. we can aim for stateless control-plane revert + operator-shim teardown. add: a preflight validator that checks config drift and DNS/BGP sanity.
Sam (Infra): preflight should include: BGP neighbor reachability, AS-preservation check, firewall egress rules, and a KV version hash compare. propose command: ```
redwood-installer --mode=operator-shim --dry-run 
  --preserve-asn=true 
  --preflight-only 
```
Rohit (Solutions): include a `--preview-plan` output that generates a machine-readable plan for netops to review. they want an exportable plan (YAML) with diffs.
Ava (PM): good—add that to criteria. also need performance guardrails: FinReg requires no >2% tail-latency regression at 99th percentile over 24h. we should tie this to launch gating.
Jose (PMM): we'll need clear messaging for customers: "preserves routing and minimizes maintenance windows". prepare comms: release notes, migration checklist, and a customer-grade runbook.
Priya (Security): legal requested retention and audit fields for upgrade actions: operator identity, timestamp, pre/post hashes. add KMS key id used in any ops.
Emily (Field): field ask: provide a small CLI `dry-run-apply` that creates a sentinel file but doesn't flip routes. netops prefers something they can run and hand off to infra.
Mira (Eng Lead): implementable: 1) preflight + preview plan 2) dry-run apply (no route flip) 3) staged cutover w/ mirroring (operator-shim) 4) smoke tests + metrics check 5) rollback (shim remove + revert control-plane flags). estimate: 4 sprints to MVP (preflight + dry-run + preview plan + docs), 2 more sprints for staged cutover and rollback automation.
Ava (PM): priority = high for FinReg POC. product asks: is staging dry-run require infra changes? Sam?
Sam (Infra): minimal infra change for operator-shim; mostly config and a lightweight proxy for mirroring. we need one extra control-plane pod in customer's cluster for shim. review security posture with Priya.
Priya (Security): acceptable if shim runs with least privilege and keys are ephemeral. require KMS integration checklist.
Rohit (Solutions): flag idea: `--preserve-telemetry=false` default. docs must show how to enable telemetry and what is collected.
Ava (PM): timeline decision: if we ship preflight + preview plan + dry-run in next release (target in 4 weeks), that covers FinReg staging. cutover automation can be next milestone. agree?
Mira (Eng Lead): feasible if we freeze other scope. call out risk: KV format compatibility may need model-compat tests. I'll add an eval harness.
Jose (PMM): I'll draft customer comms and the staged FAQ. need to know exact SLAs we can commit to for rollback window and latency regression threshold.
Ava (PM): tentative SLA commits: rollback assistance window 90 days (legal), runbook for automated rollback <30m (engineering), tail-latency regression tolerance 2% @ P99. Priya — ok to promise those to customer?
Priya (Security): legal can sign off on 90-day assistance clause but not a guarantee of full data rollback. we must be explicit in contract language.
deploy-bot: nightly build uploaded: registry.redwood/privdeploy:canary-20260322-176123.
Emily (Field): we'll need a one-pager runbook for on-call and netops during cutover. can someone own it?
Ava (PM): @Rohit take runbook owner. @Mira take engineering acceptance criteria. @Jose take comms. I'll coordinate legal and field.
Rohit (Solutions): got it — will draft runbook template and preview plan schema by EOD.
Mira (Eng Lead): will stub preflight checks and provide a PoC CLI command in 2 sprints.
Sam (Infra): I'll scope the extra control-plane pod and operator-shim infra changes and surface infra checklist.
Ava (PM): good. next sync in 3 days. action items: Rohit runbook, Mira preflight PoC, Sam infra checklist, Jose comms draft, Priya legal checklist.
Jose (PMM): :thumbsup:
Priya (Security): noted.
Emily (Field): thanks all — FinReg is breathing easier.
